lessons.title: 3. Custom Compound Hooks & State Machines
lessons.description: Build robust interactive state controllers for complex UI widgets.
lessons.content:
### Compound Component Pattern

By combining Context with sub-components, you provide flexible, ergonomic APIs for consumers:

```tsx
<Tabs defaultValue="overview">
  <Tabs.List>
    <Tabs.Trigger value="overview">Overview</Tabs.Trigger>
    <Tabs.Trigger value="reviews">Reviews</Tabs.Trigger>
  </Tabs.List>
  <Tabs.Content value="overview">Course details...</Tabs.Content>
</Tabs>
```

lessons.title: 4. Production Deployment & Telemetry Checklist
lessons.description: Prepare your full-stack bundle for production edge networks.
lessons.content:
### Production Readiness Checklist

1. Audit bundle size with `rollup-plugin-visualizer`.
2. Configure HTTP Security Headers: Content-Security-Policy, HSTS, and X-Content-Type-Options.
3. Validate client and server environment secrets separation.
4. Establish synthetic uptime monitoring.

quiz_questions.question_text: What major optimization does the React 19 Compiler provide out of the box?
quiz_questions.explanation: The React Compiler analyzes code and performs automatic fine-grained memoization without requiring manual useMemo or useCallback hooks.

options.text: It converts JSX directly into WebAssembly binary bytecode
It automatically memoizes values and functions, reducing manual useMemo/useCallback boilerplate
It forces all components to render on the server exclusively
It replaces CSS styles with inline JavaScript objects

quiz_questions.question_text: Why is modeling remote API states as Discriminated Unions superior to multiple boolean flags (isLoading, isError)?
quiz_questions.explanation: Discriminated unions ensure impossible states (such as loading AND error both being true simultaneously) cannot exist at compile time.

options.text: It decreases bundle size by over 50%
It eliminates impossible states (e.g. isLoading: true and isError: true simultaneously)
It allows bypassing TypeScript compiler checks
It makes all API calls execute synchronously

quiz_questions.question_text: Which pattern allows a parent component to implicitly share state with deeply nested child components while providing an intuitive JSX API?
quiz_questions.explanation: The Compound Component pattern (often built with React Context) enables coordinated sub-components like Select and Option.

quiz_questions.question_text: Where should progress percentages and quiz scores be calculated in a secure enterprise LMS?
quiz_questions.explanation: All calculations of course progress and quiz grades must be performed server-side to prevent tampering or client spoofing.

options.text: Exclusively on the server backend to guarantee tamper-proof records
